item.title: Private Sailing, Made Simple: How Dream Yacht’s Easy Crewed Charters Work
item.description: Dream Yacht’s Easy Crewed Charter is a simplified private yacht charter designed for people with no sailing experience, making it one of the most accessible and cost-effective ways to enjoy a sailing vacation. What Is Included with a Dream Yacht Easy Crewed Charter When you book an Easy Crewed Charter, you get a private yacht just for your group with key elements included: Professional skipper to handle navigation and safety. Private yacht accommodation for your group (cabins with beds, linens, and towels included) Insurance for the yacht and passengers Fuel, water and consumables — basics needed for your sailing itinerary Snorkeling gear and a paddleboard for watersports fun Harbor and port fees in most destinations (except ports with unreasonable rates) A hostess/cook, and half board or full board (depending on destination) These inclusions make the Easy Crewed Charter an all-in-one vacation! You arrive at the base, hop aboard, and all sailing and logistical concerns are professionally handled for you. What’s Not Included in a Dream Yacht Easy Crewed Charter The charter does not include: Flights and airport transfers. Alcoholic beverages and meals ashore. Crew gratuities, travel insurance, shore excursions, or personal expenses. This transparency helps you plan your actual trip budget up front. Privacy & Value Benefits of an Easy Crewed Charter 1. Your Private Floating Experience Unlike big cruise ships or cabin-share options, an Easy Crewed Charter gives you sole use of the entire vessel for your group. Whether it’s family, friends, or a special occasion party. This means: No strangers onboard , just people you choose to travel with Tailored itinerary , planned with your skipper based on your interests and the weather Flexible daily pace , swim, snorkel, explore ashore, or just relax without rushing 2. Ease for Non-Sailors Since the skipper handles all sailing and safety, you can enjoy the trip without sailing knowledge which is ideal for first-timers and vacationers who want comfort and convenience. 3. Better Value Compared to Luxury Crewed Charters While luxury superyacht charters can cost tens of thousands per week, Dream Yacht’s Easy Crewed option tends to be far more cost-effective because it focuses on essential services with optional upgrades (no forced inclusions of high-end extras). Many travelers find this a smart balance between privacy, professional service, and budget. Especially for group vacations of 2-12 people. Dream Yacht’s Easy Crewed Charter Destinations Dream Yacht’s Easy Crewed product is available around the world with a broad range of sailing grounds suited to varied tastes and budgets. The Caribbean Antigua British Virgin Islands Grenada Guadeloupe Martinique St. Martin Bahamas : Abaco & Exumas These spots offer turquoise water, calm sailing conditions, and beautiful beaches ideal for snorkeling and island-hopping. The Mediterranean Croatia Greece Turkey France Montenegro Perfect for history, scenic coastal towns, and classic European seaside culture. The Exotic Seychelles (Indian Ocean) Tahiti & New Caledonia (South Pacific) Belize & La Paz (Americas) Thailand (Asia) These offer a more unique, remote sailing experience among coral reefs, peaceful lagoons, and dramatic island landscapes. Explore The World on a Dream Yacht Easy Crewed Vacation The Easy Crewed Charter is a practical, budget-friendly way to enjoy private sailing without needing any sailing skills. It bundles the essentials; yacht, skipper, basic amenities, and some watersports gear, while giving you the privacy and freedom of your own floating vacation home. Whether you choose a tropical Caribbean loop, a Mediterranean island hop, or an exotic Pacific adventure, you control the pace, places, and experiences, all with professional support and minimal stress. item.title: Savor the journey: Slow travel to a Med sailing paradise
item.description: As the world becomes increasingly fast-paced and disconnected, a growing number of travelers are seeking a more relaxed and immersive way to spend their precious holiday time with loved ones. This is where the concept of “slow travel” comes in – a trend that’s all about embracing the journey, not just the destination. By ditching the hustle and bustle of flights and connections, slow travelers can unwind, soak up the scenery, and make the relaxed journey a welcome part of their unique holiday experience. For travelers located in Europe, Dream Yacht’s popular charter destinations are particularly well-suited to help you jump aboard the slow travel trend. With base location in some of the Mediterranean’s most sought-after and accessible destinations such as Croatia , Mallorca and Corsica , you can easily combine your overland journey with a relaxing yacht charter vacation, exploring the crystal-clear waters and charming islands of the Mediterranean at your own pace. Not only does slow travel reduce carbon emissions and promote sustainability, but it also allows you to connect with local cultures, meet fellow travelers, and experience the authentic charm of Europe’s hidden gems. As people increasingly seek meaningful and environmentally-friendly travel experiences, it’s no wonder that slow travel has become a popular option for those seeking to reach the balmy Mediterranean in style. With our wide range of sailing itineraries and flexible charter options , Dream Yacht provides the perfect platform for slow travelers to unwind and immerse themselves in the unique culture and beauty of the Mediterranean. Ready to slow down? Why consider slower, immersive travel Slow travel often encourages travelers to adopt a more mindful and immersive approach to their journey, which can lead to a greater appreciation for local cultures and environments. By taking the time to explore destinations at a leisurely pace, travelers are more likely to engage with local communities, support small businesses, and respect the natural beauty of the places they visit. Imagine meandering through picturesque landscapes by train, watching the countryside roll by as you sip coffee or enjoy a leisurely lunch. Or, picture yourself cruising across calm waters by ferry, feeling the sea breeze on your face as you gaze out at the horizon. For those heading to popular Mediterranean yacht charter destinations, slow travel is the perfect way to set the tone for a relaxing and rejuvenating oceanic getaway. By combining train or ferry travel with a yacht charter vacation, guests can indulge in a unique and unforgettable slow travel experience that combines the best of both worlds — scenic overland journeys and tranquil seascapes. Slow travel for reduced emissions Your slow travel journey can also help to reduce waste and promote sustainable tourism practices, such as choosing eco-friendly accommodations and activities. In particular, traveling by train and ferry can significantly help reduce carbon footprint compared to flying. Trains and ferries generally produce fewer greenhouse gas emissions per passenger than planes. According to the European Environment Agency, trains produce around 14 grams of CO2 per passenger-kilometer, while ferries produce around 21 grams of CO2 per passenger-kilometer. In contrast, planes produce around 285 grams of CO2 per passenger-kilometer. Trains and ferries are shared modes of transportation, which means that the emissions are spread out among a larger number of passengers. This makes them a more environmentally friendly option than driving. Perhaps try one of these CO2 calculators to see how much more efficient your journey could be! www.ecopassenger.org/ www.greentripper.org/ Slow travel routes to Dream Yacht bases from France & the UK Several Dream Yacht locations are quite accessible from France and the UK, offering a tantalizing escape to a sun-kissed Mediterranean paradise with just a few hours of travel.
